At minimum DPAPI-wrap it like android.keystore.pw next to it. Keep .ccsync-release out of agent scope. Bake an emergency key and write a compromise runbook.

findings.known: operator caution in INDEXERS.md; the loss and re-mint unrecorded

findings.title: release('done') with unfinished items ends the batch 'done', leaves invisible 'ingesting' rows holding names, and nothing can retry them
findings.recommendation: In release(done) mark every unfinished item failed with a reason; log the mismatch.

findings.title: A client link built against a public base with no explicit port keeps the dashboard's own port, so the link is dead for the client
findings.recommendation: Use new URL(local.pathname, cf.publicBase) or set port explicitly; add a test.

findings.title: Preview stills are keyed by videos.id in one shared folder while the base rig, fleet ingest and the drain mint ids independently (still open)
findings.recommendation: Implement the owner's pending option (A): a disjoint fleet id range kept by the drain plus a one-off rename.
findings.known: bug-broll-3 (2026-09-24), DEFERRED for the owner, OPEN

findings.title: The public media gate re-resolves the whole folder on every thumbnail after any renumber and never heals
findings.recommendation: Rewrite the stored video_id when resolution finds a new id, or cache per (folder, search_generation); consider a per-token budget.

findings.title: Publishing music.db deletes every fleet-ingested track and the whole batch ledger
findings.recommendation: Drain and merge fleet rows and the ledger like b-roll, or refuse while the live file holds ingest_items the source lacks; correct SPECS and DEPLOY.md.
findings.known: CR-152 fixed the b-roll half only

findings.title: A new customer with no GPU base rig gets a music page whose search 500s and whose fleet-ingested tracks are never tagged
findings.recommendation: Ship the text tower as a sha-pinned feed artefact fetched by the container or wizard; until then report DEGRADED and hide search instead of 500ing.
findings.known: only an operator NOTE in install_dashboard_app.py

findings.title: A dropped connection or timeout on the music result POST fails the track for good (and can strand a track row)
findings.recommendation: Treat transport errors as retryable with backoff; set embedded only after 200; re-POST when dest_name is empty; pre-warm the encoder at mount.
findings.known: music-2 covers only 503 and name_race

findings.title: A track that fails after its result keeps a library row with no audio, which also blocks re-dropping it
findings.recommendation: Drop unlanded rows of failed items on every terminal release and in lease expiry, or ignore failed-item rows in duplicate checks.
findings.known: bug-music-ytdl-4 fixed the cancelled path only

findings.title: One malformed window vector takes text search and 'similar' down for the whole fleet, and it survives restarts
findings.recommendation: 422 or drop wrong-width windows; have the loaders skip and log bad rows.

findings.title: Any write to music.db (heartbeat, checkpoint, waveform cache) makes the next search rebuild the whole index
findings.recommendation: Key staleness on a revision counter bumped by writers of tracks/windows/debias; keep the inode check for swaps.

findings.title: Preview proxies from the base rig can play another track's audio after a drain, because ids diverge
findings.recommendation: Key proxies by a stable value (content hash or rel_path digest) or verify (id, rel_path) on push.
findings.known: related to music-4 (fixed in-process path)

findings.title: Turning the YouTube downloader OFF does not stop the server downloading, and hands in-flight local downloads to the server IP
findings.where: dashboard ytdl.py:468-578, 806-819 (YtdlFeatureGate); ytdl/web/ytdlweb/worker.py:170-201, 244-320; ytdlp_nightly.py:440-470; companion ytdl_executor.py:388
findings.recommendation: Give the worker, canary and refresher the cached feature predicate and idle while off; do not reclaim leases while off; show paused jobs; test a mid-job flip.

findings.title: A deleted person's username stays in manifest.json files in the footage tree
findings.recommendation: Stop writing the username (stand-in or nothing) or rewrite manifests in forget_requester; mention in export and PRIVACY.md.

findings.title: TrueNAS setup_editor_account.py takes over any existing account, admin and root included
findings.recommendation: Port _refuse_non_editor into TrueNASBackend create/update (builtin, uid<1000, not already in editors, the [nas] admin_user); add tests.

findings.title: run.sh image mode: docker stop kills PID 1 before uvicorn finishes shutting down
findings.recommendation: Loop `while kill -0 $app_pid; do wait $app_pid || rc=$?; done` before choosing the exit code, or exec a supervisor.
findings.known: WPK-3 (open, generic)

findings.title: Image-mode deploys fail their own health gate whenever the image is not the checkout's VERSION
findings.recommendation: In image mode compare against the image/current.json version or accept any healthy answer; drop the bind rollback line there.

findings.title: Optional Postgres profile publishes a superuser with Resolve's default password on all interfaces
findings.recommendation: Bind to DASH_BIND_* and require ${PG_PASSWORD:?}; refuse 'DaVinci'.

findings.title: The 'scoped' TrueNAS API key is still root-equivalent
findings.recommendation: Require a dedicated --username; document residual root equivalence; seek a narrower privilege or move account writes out of the container.
findings.known: COMMERCIAL_READINESS item 6 / H3 (treated as mitigated)

findings.title: Live b-roll databases sit in the editor-writable SMB share
findings.recommendation: Move the databases to a private app data dir (as music.db is) and share only media; at minimum 0600 service-owned in a non-editor-writable subdir.

findings.title: A Syncthing installed by winget gets its versioned package folder baked into the logon shim, so winget upgrade silently kills lane C
findings.recommendation: Always run our pinned copy from $BinDir, or resolve to the stable WinGet\Links path.

findings.title: Re-running the wizard silently downgrades the companion to whatever build that onboard.exe bundled, skipping the floor
findings.recommendation: Read the installed version first and keep a newer build (or warn); same guard in windows_upgrade.ps1.

findings.title: A tree-drive letter held by a real volume is read as free: install says DONE with no tree drive and a logon task that fails at every logon
findings.recommendation: Check whether the letter is in use at all before mapping and treat a foreign one as a capability miss; verify after mapping; refuse in the wizard.
findings.known: CR-153/OPS-1 covers the mapped-foreign case only

findings.title: Any Syncthing the editor already runs is taken to be ours (lane C wired to the wrong instance, DONE shown), and the Windows uninstaller kills it
findings.recommendation: Use the wizard's managed-directory filter in all three scripts; give ours its own ports or record a named capability miss.
findings.known: INST-20 fixed in the wizard and macos_uninstall.sh only

findings.title: Every wizard install blocks ALL inbound SMB (139/445) on every network profile, with no opt-out and no notice
findings.recommendation: Avoid or scope the change; detect existing shares and ask or report; document for customer IT.
findings.known: COMMERCIAL_READINESS item 15 introduced the rule; side effect unrecorded

findings.title: Dashboard file moves are applied on disk during a halt
findings.recommendation: Answer pending moves 'retrying' while halted.

findings.title: A watchdog restart of a dead sequencer silently undoes Pause and the drive-out pause
findings.recommendation: Re-apply pause after a watchdog restart when _paused or _root_absent.

findings.title: Lane completion events are drained before the POST and lost when it fails
findings.recommendation: Hold drained completions and resend until a post succeeds.

findings.title: Pushed update and auto-update on one reply race; the loser records a false 'Update failed'
findings.recommendation: Return a distinct 'already applying' outcome and treat it as a stand-down.

findings.title: Bin-only non-canonical clips are latched once per process even when the relink fails
findings.recommendation: Discard the key on a refused relink and for unreachable items.
findings.known: RES-19 fixed the watcher half only

findings.title: A Windows shutdown/log-off is never stamped clean for the crash-loop counter, so reboots after an update can revert a good build
findings.recommendation: Call upgrade.note_clean_shutdown in the session-end callback.

findings.title: Restarting the watcher thread clears the process-wide stop event, which can undo a racing shutdown
findings.recommendation: Give the watcher its own stop event; never clear _stop_event.

findings.title: 'Copy diagnostics' says the bundle was sent to the admin when it was not
findings.recommendation: Toast 'copied', then report the upload's real outcome.

findings.title: Removal gate rewrites lane A's shared filter file without exclusions, racing a run's startup
findings.recommendation: Give probes their own filter file.

findings.title: A Windows TCP-table read failure yields ABSENT instead of UNKNOWN (spurious disconnections)
findings.recommendation: Retry on error 122 with the new size; raise so the probe answers UNKNOWN.

findings.title: Undo's cross-project guard compares 80-char slugs, so similar project names replay each other's journals
findings.recommendation: Compare raw stored names; hash the full name into the slug.

findings.title: The stills 'gallery moved' message prints a forward slash on Windows
findings.recommendation: Resolve None to os.name == 'nt' before choosing the separator.

findings.title: Settings [ GIVE THIS COMPUTER A NEW ID ] opens a Tk dialog without taking _popup_active_lock
findings.recommendation: Take the lock non-blocking with the standard toast.

findings.title: A dashboard_url with an explicit default port (:443/:80) makes every Send to Resolve 403
findings.recommendation: Normalise default ports before building origins.

findings.title: A jobs_kinds typo turns a restriction into 'take every kind'
findings.recommendation: Take no work when a non-empty setting yields no known kind; warn in Settings.

findings.title: The peaks recipe buffers the whole decode in the tray process (~1-2 GB for long files)
findings.recommendation: Bin while streaming, O(bins) memory.

findings.title: A yt-dlp self-update whose new binary cannot be read is published as ok under the old version
findings.recommendation: Treat updated-but-unreadable as its own failed outcome with the short retry.

findings.title: The executor's 'old yt-dlp' poke is swallowed by CR-361's 20 h update throttle
findings.recommendation: Pass a force flag from the poke (keep one per job, 1 h floor).

findings.title: A stop just after yt-dlp finishes leaves the clip under its deliverable name, never probed
findings.recommendation: Move a landed file onto the staging name so the sweep removes it.
findings.known: related to CR-327 (fixed)

findings.title: /ytdl/fetch will pull any file under Projects/ from the NAS, not only YouTube originals
findings.recommendation: Require <label>/Youtube/ and a video extension (optionally a synced label).

findings.title: A Resolve project name over 256 chars gets every heavy report refused while its journal is among the newest 20
findings.recommendation: Cap 'project' in the companion and add a truncating validator.

findings.title: A shared-token holder can stamp 'being turned away' on any editor's computer and trigger report_refused alerts
findings.recommendation: Stamp only when the credential proves that editor.

findings.title: Job claim trusts the machine name in its body, so a hostname target can be claimed by any editor (and cooldowns evaded)
findings.recommendation: Refuse a claim whose machine is not in machines_of(editor); match targets as editor/machine.

findings.title: A file move can overwrite a file that appears at the destination after the exists() check
findings.recommendation: Use a no-replace rename or re-check immediately before.
findings.known: related to CR-333 (OPEN)

findings.title: Per-machine storage bounds (diagnostics, pending SSH keys) are keyed on a caller-chosen machine name
findings.recommendation: Per-editor caps; refuse diagnostics for unregistered machines.

findings.title: Publish-time prune deletes recalled rows and builds a machine has a pending push for
findings.recommendation: Exclude retracted rows and versions named by pending pushes (or keep the row, drop only the file).

findings.title: The first local admin is whoever reaches /api/v1/setup/admin first
findings.recommendation: Require a one-time setup code generated at first boot.
findings.known: related to 09-24 bug-dash-auth-1 (window scope, fixed)

findings.title: The SMB guest/null-session rejection is dead code (session_flags never exists)
findings.recommendation: Check session.session_key is None after connect or pin require_signing=True; add a test.

findings.title: Non-ASCII header/query values 500 two pre-auth comparisons (internal sftp bearer, OIDC state)
findings.recommendation: Route through api.token_ok or catch TypeError.

findings.title: /broll, /music, /ytdl writes skip CSRF and Origin checks and rely on SameSite=Lax alone
findings.recommendation: Apply _origin_mismatch to these prefixes as for /cards/.
findings.known: deliberate interim exemption

findings.title: File-move reconciliation can delete the row of a move still in progress, so the fleet is never told
findings.recommendation: Reconcile only rows older than a grace period or share a lock; check complete_file_move's rowcount.

findings.title: Snapshot restore follows symlinks, copying container files (e.g. secrets) into the Projects tree
findings.recommendation: Walk and copy with follow_symlinks=False; skip and name symlinks.

findings.title: Whether a spent media job is pinned or abandoned depends on whether a Cards episode happens to be open
findings.recommendation: Make available() true when the checkout exposes fleet_execute; let tick wait for an engine.

findings.title: Re-running Codex SET UP for the installed version deletes the live install before unpacking
findings.recommendation: Unpack into <version>.new and swap atomically, or skip an identical version.

findings.title: A long project name with no spaces makes the project page scroll sideways
findings.recommendation: overflow-wrap:anywhere and min-width:0 on .head h1/.sub; add a test.

findings.title: The /help markdown renderer escapes link targets twice, so & in a URL breaks
findings.recommendation: Unescape before escaping, or match links before escaping; add a test.

findings.title: The new alert-kinds form blanks its All / Problems only / None buttons while saving
findings.recommendation: Give the preset keys a .busy-t or scope the rule to [data-busy].
findings.known: new uncommitted code

findings.title: The installer 404 shown to an editor tells admins to run a vendor-only release tool
findings.recommendation: Point admins at Settings > Packages instead.
findings.known: CR-59 left this sentence

findings.title: An installed Cards app's sign-in page is outside the app's scope (possible iOS sign-in loop)
findings.recommendation: Test on iOS/Android; add a /cards/login alias or widen scope.

findings.title: Concurrent publishes of one version escape as IntegrityError, orphaning a .part and failing check_now
findings.recommendation: Catch IntegrityError, roll back, unlink the part, re-run the comparison; or lock.

findings.title: Licence tools pip-install unpinned pip-licenses into the venv they judge; PyInstaller is pinned but not hashed
findings.recommendation: Hashed tools lock, throwaway venv with --python; hash-pin PyInstaller and hooks.

findings.title: check_deploy_drift.ps1 POSTs the admin password through redirect-following calls with no cleartext guard
findings.recommendation: -MaximumRedirection 0 on every call; refuse http:// to public hosts.

findings.title: The selector's scoped tier never runs licence/notices checks, so allowlist or notices-input changes pass locally
findings.recommendation: Give those files a tier-full row or let an area require full checks.

findings.title: check_licenses judges the container's packages from other venvs, at other versions
findings.recommendation: Scan a venv built from the container lock, or match on (name, version).

findings.title: The opt-in YouTube-unblock dependency set (GPLv3) is in no gate
findings.recommendation: Add a named CI step for dashboard-container-unblock.
findings.known: by design, unenforced

findings.title: The bench scratch-path guard accepts '..' traversal and any component containing '_bench'
findings.recommendation: Refuse '..'; require a component equal to '_bench'.

findings.title: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES still says the NAS runs the lock-pinned yt-dlp; since CR-361 it runs an unpinned PyPI nightly
findings.recommendation: Update the row; extend gen_notices and the LG-16 drift check to the nightly path.
findings.known: follows CR-361

findings.title: A shoot name equal to an indexer share re-files its collection and makes every later drain treat base-rig rows as dashboard-only
findings.recommendation: Refuse such names; validate collection; drain by ingest_items.video_id.
findings.theme: B-roll, music and YouTube web apps

findings.title: The expired/revoked share page shows the curator's login username to anyone with the old link
findings.recommendation: Show only the contact or a display name.
findings.theme: B-roll, music and YouTube web apps

findings.title: record_view on the public folder route is unguarded against a locked ledger, so a client can get a 500
findings.recommendation: Wrap in try/except sqlite3.Error.
findings.theme: B-roll, music and YouTube web apps

findings.title: Music fleet routes accept unvalidated shapes: 'live' via /status skips the upload check; nested probe values 500
findings.recommendation: Refuse 'live' in set_item_state; type the probe model and bound ints.
findings.theme: B-roll, music and YouTube web apps

findings.title: Inline base-rig music ingest leaves the uploaded file in the library with no row when analysis raises
findings.recommendation: Unlink or restore dest on any exception after the move.
findings.theme: B-roll, music and YouTube web apps

findings.title: A job whose last owed clip is server-held waits a full lease (~180 s) before finishing
findings.recommendation: Re-check unfinished_downloads after a clip under a live lease and close out.
findings.theme: B-roll, music and YouTube web apps

findings.title: Worker waits out the local-claim grace on jobs pinned to the server
findings.recommendation: Return False when mode_lock is 'server'.
findings.theme: B-roll, music and YouTube web apps

findings.title: No cap on how many searches one editor can queue
findings.recommendation: Per-editor queue limit with a 409 naming it.
findings.theme: B-roll, music and YouTube web apps

findings.title: Two rename sequences (db swap sidecars, rollback one-liner) can leave the live thing missing or nested on partial failure
findings.recommendation: Guard the sidecar moves; use && and shell_quote in the rollback.

findings.title: Pinned ffmpeg URL points at a directory the upstream prunes (and is amd64-only)
findings.recommendation: Self-host the pinned tarball with the GPL source offer; surface a missing ffmpeg.

findings.title: TrueNAS custom_app body carries secrets unescaped through compose interpolation ($ in a password)
findings.recommendation: Escape $ as $$ or refuse, as render_env_file does; add a test.

findings.title: The wizard's schtasks 'not found' check fails on non-English Windows
findings.recommendation: Check existence with schtasks /Query exit code or Get-ScheduledTask.

findings.title: macOS default uninstall deletes the Syncthing device identity; Windows default keeps it
findings.recommendation: Keep syncthing-config unless --full.
